visual_elements.description: Single-layer perceptron neural network diagram. Left column of input entries stacked top-to-bottom: x_1, x_2, x_3, vertical ellipsis, x_n, plus a bias input '1' at the bottom (6 stacked entries total). Exactly 3 summation nodes are drawn as light blue #c0c0ff circles each containing a black 'Σ': top (neuron 1), middle (neuron 2), bottom (neuron m), with one vertical ellipsis between the middle and bottom Σ. Weight lines fan from every input to each Σ: red #ff0000 lines to the top Σ labeled w_{11}, w_{12}, w_{13}, ..., w_{1n}, b_1; blue #0000ff lines to the middle Σ labeled w_{21}, w_{22}, w_{23}, ..., w_{2n}, b_2; green #008000 lines to the bottom Σ labeled w_{m1}, w_{m2}, ..., w_{mn}, b_m; the b labels sit on the lines coming from the bias input '1'. Each Σ connects via a red #ff0000 arrow to a purple #d0b0ff rectangular activation box (3 boxes, no inner text specified). To the right of each activation box, two stacked black output lines: '>0 Class I' / '<0 Not Class I'; '>0 Class II' / '<0 Not Class II'; one vertical ellipsis between the second and last output rows; '>0 Class m' / '<0 Not Class m'.
Rounded rectangle with light peach background #fdebd0 containing the three equations for d_1(X), d_2(X), and d_m(X) in black text with subscript/superscript formatting.
Tan rectangle #e6d5b8 containing the text 'Multi-Class Classification' in dark brown #5c4a2a, smaller font than the equations.
Circle outline containing the slide number '6' in black text; white fill #ffffff with light gray outline #c0c0c0.

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large and bold: 'Visualization of' and 'Perceptron' in red #c00000, 'Single Layer' in blue #0000ff. Body text is regular weight black. Equations use subscript notation (w_{11}, x_1, b_1) and the superscript T in W^T. The 'Multi-Class Classification' label is in a smaller font inside the tan box (source said 'serif or sans-serif'; sans-serif assumed for consistency).

recreation_brief:
1. SLIDE SETUP: Set the slide background to solid light gray #f2f2f2. Use one sans-serif font family for all text. No animations; every element below is static and fully visible.
2. TITLE: Insert a text box across the top of the slide (top band, ~8% of slide height, starting at the left edge and extending about half the slide width, keeping the top-right corner free). Type exactly: 'Visualization of Single Layer Perceptron'. Make it the largest, bold sans-serif text on the slide. Color 'Visualization of' red #c00000, 'Single Layer' blue #0000ff, and 'Perceptron' red #c00000.
3. SLIDE NUMBER: Draw a circle (oval) in the top-right corner with white fill #ffffff and light gray outline #c0c0c0. Center the black text '6' inside it.
4. EQUATION BOX: In the left column (~40% of slide width), directly below the title, draw a rounded rectangle filled peach #fdebd0, about 20% of the slide height. Inside, left-aligned black text, three lines with subscripts and superscript T rendered properly:
   Line 1: d_1(X) = W_1^T X = w_{11}x_1 + w_{12}x_2 + ... + w_{1n}x_n + b_1 * 1
   Line 2: d_2(X) = W_2^T X = w_{21}x_1 + w_{22}x_2 + ... + w_{2n}x_n + b_2 * 1
   Line 3: d_m(X) = W_m^T X = w_{m1}x_1 + w_{m2}x_2 + ... + w_{mn}x_n + b_m * 1
   (render as d₁, W₁ᵀ, w₁₁x₁, b₁ etc.; keep the literal '... ' and '* 1' as shown).
5. CLASSIFICATION LABEL: Below the equation box in the left column (middle-lower area), draw a rectangle filled tan #e6d5b8 containing the text 'Multi-Class Classification' in dark brown #5c4a2a, at a smaller font size than the equations.
6. DIAGRAM AREA: On the right side (~60% of slide width, from vertical middle to bottom, ~60% of slide height), lay out the perceptron diagram on a white #ffffff area; use light blue #e6f3ff for the input node fills (see validation note).
7. INPUT COLUMN: Along the far left edge of the diagram, stack 6 entries top-to-bottom as small circles filled #e6f3ff with black labels: 'x_1', 'x_2', 'x_3', a vertical ellipsis (source shows '...'; render stacked vertically), 'x_n', and the bias input '1' at the bottom.
8. SUMMATION COLUMN: To the right of the input column (leaving space for the fan-in lines), draw exactly 3 circles filled light blue #c0c0ff, each containing a black 'Σ', aligned vertically: top Σ (neuron 1), middle Σ (neuron 2), bottom Σ (neuron m). Place one vertical ellipsis between the middle and bottom Σ.
9. WEIGHTS TO TOP Σ: Draw straight red #ff0000 lines from every input entry to the top Σ. Label each line in black near the line: 'w_{11}' (from x_1), 'w_{12}' (from x_2), 'w_{13}' (from x_3), 'w_{1n}' (from x_n), and 'b_1' (from the bias '1'). The '...' in the label list denotes omitted intermediate weights; no extra labels are drawn.
10. WEIGHTS TO MIDDLE Σ: Draw straight blue #0000ff lines from every input entry to the middle Σ, labeled 'w_{21}' (x_1), 'w_{22}' (x_2), 'w_{23}' (x_3), 'w_{2n}' (x_n), and 'b_2' (bias '1').
11. WEIGHTS TO BOTTOM Σ: Draw straight green #008000 lines from every input entry to the bottom Σ, labeled 'w_{m1}' (x_1), 'w_{m2}' (x_2), 'w_{mn}' (x_n), and 'b_m' (bias '1').
12. ACTIVATION BOXES: From each Σ, draw a short red #ff0000 arrow pointing right to a purple #d0b0ff rectangle (activation box). Draw exactly 3 rectangles, vertically aligned with their Σ circles; leave them without inner text.
13. OUTPUTS: To the right of each activation box, add two stacked lines of black text. Top box: '>0 Class I' over '<0 Not Class I'. Middle box: '>0 Class II' over '<0 Not Class II'. Place one vertical ellipsis between the middle output row and the last output row. Bottom box: '>0 Class m' over '<0 Not Class m'.
14. FINAL CHECK: All text is black except the title's red/blue words; all fonts sans-serif; equations keep subscript/superscript formatting; background is #f2f2f2; no elements other than steps 2-13 appear on the slide.
